Now they are trying to bypass Russia’s authorities.

This illegal activity in Russia is a criminal offence.

 But Moldovans who remember their history reject attempts to whitewash Hitler’s accomplices.

 4 years ago, military correspondent Daria Dugina was killed in a Ukrainian terrorist attack.

The situation in Kosovo & Metohija points to intensifying deliberate & systematic terror against the local Serb population, perpetrated by the Provisional Institutions in Pristina with the tacit approval of NATO, EU & UN presences.

Russia’s EMERCOM continues battling wildfires in Serbia.

On its first day of operations, Russia’s EMERCOM Il-76 aircraft carried out 5 sorties & 10 water drops, releasing a total of 210 tonnes of water over the fire zones.

 #RussiaSerbia

On August 20, President  #Putin visited the Archangel Cathedral of the Moscow Kremlin, where the relics of Grand Prince Dmitry #Donskoy were uncovered.

 Patriarch Kirill blessed three fragments of the relics to be placed in reliquaries for veneration by the faithful.

#Zakharova: Invitations to observe the September State Duma elections have been sent to 12 international organisations & over 100 countries.

Representatives of 55 states have already confirmed participation – including Russia’s partners in the #CIS, #SCO, #BRICS & #ASEAN.
